title: Disney laser-plasma electronic fireworks

tellings.quote:
Well, when I was at Disney, we were
developing electronic fireworks. And the
way we did it is we had a Q switch
neodyenium yag laser that we focused to
a spot in the atmosphere and we put so
much energy there that we ionized the
air and created ball lightning.

plain: While working at Walt Disney Imagineering, the company's design and engineering arm, Eric Haseltine says his team built electronic fireworks out of light. They pointed a powerful pulsed laser at one spot in the sky and poured in so much energy that the air turned into glowing charged gas, "ball lightning." Haseltine, billed on the show as a former director at the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for communications, describes this as work he did himself.
